title: Bread in the Meadow
lines: Sam wanted to have lunch in the meadow.
He had a heavy bag of fresh bread.
The weather was hot and his head got wet.
He spread a red rug on the grass.
A crow left a feather by his bread.
Then it took the bread and flew off!
Sam was not ready for that at all.

questions.ask: Where did Sam want to have his lunch?
questions.listenFor: In the meadow. Have them point to the first line.

questions.ask: What did the crow leave, and what did it take?
questions.listenFor: It left a feather and took the bread. Listen for both.

questions.ask: What do you think Sam did next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine if it fits the story. Listen for a reason.
